```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Load in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(sqldf)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
GeneCovariate=read.csv(file="GSE85307_covar-1.csv", row.names=1)
GeneExpression= read.csv(file="GSE85307_geneExpression.csv", row.names = 1)
GeneName= read.csv(file="GSE85307_geneNames.csv", row.names = 1)
```

Create columns for identifiers
```{r}
GeneExpression[,"GeneNumber"] <- rownames(GeneExpression)
GeneName[,"GeneNumber"] <- rownames(GeneName)
```

Joining Gene Expression and Gene Name together
```{r}
GeneExp_Name<- merge(GeneExpression, GeneName, by="GeneNumber", all=TRUE)
Clean_GeneExp_Name <- na.omit(GeneExp_Name)
```

Create row for identifiers
```{r}
Clean_GeneExp_Name["geoID",] <- colnames(Clean_GeneExp_Name)
```

Transpose Gene Expression
```{r}
Transp_Clean_GeneExp_Name <- as.data.frame(t(Clean_GeneExp_Name))
```

Add a column named geoID for identifiers
```{r}
Transp_Clean_GeneExp_Name["geoID"] <- rownames(Transp_Clean_GeneExp_Name)
```

Merge all data together in one dataframe, under geoID
```{r}
All_Data<- merge(Transp_Clean_GeneExp_Name, GeneCovariate, by="geoID", all=TRUE)
```
